_header: A byte-for-byte capture of the changes tab of MAM's old Google Sheet, through its published CSV, for the change-log credits of doc/PLAN-change-log-credits.md, Phase 3.
Captured once, read-only, through mb_cmn.polite_download with obey_robots_txt=True. Never normalize or edit changes.csv.
Record 1 is the freeze banner and record 2 the header, so a data record's one-based index is its row in the Sheet.
